objective: Build first playable Living Kingdom Godot DEV vertical slice with 13 realm identities and 39 canonical game-linked local adventure specifications, without retiring original games or reopening Arena/estate. Add 13 distinct procedural realm art directions, bounded props, guide dialogue, dynamic lighting and realm-specific mission layouts. Replace existing sprite guides and shared explorer rig with 13 original generated articulated GLBs, new animation tracks and original synthesized audio. Replace imported Kingdom environment props with original procedural geometry and surface shader, and wire interactive animation and sound. Upgrade character mesh topology to actual glTF skinned skeletons, material-batched surfaces, blended joint weights, facial and hand detail, denser authored motion. Add 13 original realm audio soundscapes and acceleration/deceleration matched to native animation. Embed original procedural PBR texture maps, fit bind-pose ground alignment, sculpt irregular terrain, instanced foliage, masonry windows and flowing water effects. Add tangent-correct original PBR meshes, 44.1 kHz audio, continuous loop crossfades and fail-closed binary validation. Refine toy-like silhouettes with continuous sculpted sections, tailored costumes, facial anatomy, tapered limbs and session-local explorer selection. Add 13 distinct landmark architectures, gradient sky and cinematic event FX, separate cached footsteps and crossfaded realm ambience. Tailor all thirteen costumes, facial contours and role motion amplitudes; enforce original costume uniqueness in media validation. Reject incomplete catalogs or missing skeletons, guides, and landmarks before enabling native adventures. Add six weighted secondary joints per hero for blinks, mouth movement, hair and coat follow-through; make NPCs turn toward the explorer and respond to mission context. Author 39 canonical mission-specific field challenges across six actual interaction rule families, with progress credited only after a valid local solution and physical arrival. Vary encounter tile layouts, conceal pair values, validate challenge input, prevent out-of-order marker access and exercise all 104 field objectives in headless smoke. Replace nine generic objectives with native match-three swap/clear puzzles, adjacent equal-tier merges, timed planting/watering/harvest and beat-window rhythm interactions. Add exhaustive advanced board solvability gates, three board orientations, explicit negative runtime checks and original pitched rhythm tones.
